description.value:
Trigger You critically fail a skill check that would cause you to fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], or an enemy succeeds at a skill check that would cause you to fall prone.

When you're about to fall, you twirl your arms comically to attempt to keep your balance. Attempt a @Check[performance] check against the same DC of the triggering skill check that you critically failed or the enemy's skill DC for the skill it used to knock you prone.

Critical Success You don't fall prone. A creature of your choice adjacent to you finds your performance so funny it can't use reactions for 1 round; this is a mental and emotion effect.

Success You don't fall prone.
